title: G6 Android Pie Active Sensor Session Won't Connect
symptom: xDrip+ will not connect to the Dexcom G6 transmitter with an active sensor session in progress. The status page shows perpetual scanning and messages like 'Now start your sensor or check settings' and 'G6 State isn't currently known.'
cause: Running the official Dexcom G6 app simultaneously with xDrip+ causes the connection issue; they cannot run at the same time.
fix: Uninstall the official Dexcom app from the phone to allow xDrip+ to connect.
evidence_quote: Uninstall official dexcom app from your phone. This is causing your problem. They can't run at the same time
